# Multicargo Logistics Group

> Multicargo (ТОВ «Мультикарго») is an international freight forwarder. Team experience in freight forwarding since 2008; Multicargo has operated as an independent company since 2013. We organise air, sea, rail and road shipments, customs clearance and related services for businesses (B2B) between Asia, the Americas, Israel, the UAE, Europe and Ukraine. Works for one pallet or 100 containers.

## Services
- Air freight
- Sea freight (FCL/LCL)
- Road transport
- Rail freight
- LCL and groupage
- Oversized cargo
- Technical importer services (EU/Ukraine)
- Courier services
- Port and air handling
- Customs clearance

## Offices
Kyiv (UA), Warsaw (PL), Wroclaw (PL), Valencia (ES), Tallinn (EE), Shenzhen (CN)
